in_marathi.name: Adhideep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of the inner self
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhideep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Adhideep is derived from Sanskrit words 'adh' (inner) and 'deep' (light). It represents the inner light of one's own soul and is believed to bring wisdom and knowledge. This name is often given to boys to inspire them to seek inner wisdom and enlightenment.
